base:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create original high-quality pixel art for a personal website: Cornell University's Baker Laboratory and adjacent Physical Sciences Building (PSB), as a wide landscape scene, roughly 3:1 aspect ratio, 1536x512 if possible. The supplied photo is ARCHITECTURAL REFERENCE ONLY, do not pixelate or trace the photograph. Recompose the campus to clearly show Baker's symmetrical long grey-brown masonry facade, flat parapets, central monumental tall pale stone columns and dark entrance, repetitive tall narrow windows and climbing ivy; adjacent PSB on RIGHT with modern blue-green glass curtain walls, bright pale horizontal floor bands and thin white vertical mullions. Baker LEFT/CENTER, PSB RIGHT, visually attached. Straight architectural lines, believable slightly oblique street-level view from sloping lawn, curved walkway leading to Baker's central entrance and a few shallow stone steps. Mature trees FRAME both extreme edges, a couple smaller trees but leave central columns visible. No giant foreground obstruction. No other buildings or huts. No water/lake. No text, logos, watermark, UI or labels.
Style: lovingly hand-drawn 1990s adventure game background, cohesive chunky crisp pixel clusters, limited muted palette, strong silhouette detail, selective dithering, no photorealism, no smooth digital painting, no isometric miniature. Preserve recognizability rather than generic campus. Include enough architectural detail at website banner scale.
Variant 01 SPRING MORNING: soft pale blue sky and warm peach light, fresh soft green foliage, sunlit limestone, subdued cyan glazing, fresh green lawn. Some low mist in distance, peaceful atmosphere. Keep sky top quarter calm and relatively empty for later website text. Produce one finished scene, not a montage.
